summary: Wings, hats, halos, masks, shoulder pieces, auras and trails are drawn on their own model instead of being forced through the vanilla cape slot, so they no longer come out as a garbled cape, and animated pieces play frame by frame in the world. The owner's own picture ships inside the companion jar as the Minecraft main menu background. Cosmetic tiles on the website, the account page and the admin panel show square and animated pieces whole instead of cropping them like a cape sheet.
